claims.text: The experiment evaluated the performance of hotel2vec embeddings by analyzing learning curves and the effect of hyperparameters such as the number of negative samples and learning rate.
The evaluation included calculating the average similarity between pairs of markets to assess how well market-level information was encoded in the embeddings.
The enriched model was compared to the session-only model, demonstrating superior performance in both general and filtered scenarios.
